column1: # Measured from the sender's encoded track read at the local relay with tatolab-read-track and decoded by ffmpeg to RGB PNGs. Earlier baselines were measured over the deleted exchange route from the engine decoder's pixels; do not compare the two.
# Red reads about 0.89 because the encoder converts RGB with BT.709 while its VUI names the frame's own SMPTE 170M matrix, which ffmpeg honours; correcting either moves this baseline.
# Default verification tolerance is ±0.05 absolute on the [0,1] scale.
